Definition: from G575 and G2343; to treasure away:--lay up in store.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells the rich to lay up in store for themselves a good foundation for the time to come, treasuring away something that will last. The storing is the same habit as hoarding, turned toward eternity instead of toward self.
TheologicalSignificance: The question is never whether we store up, but what we store, and where.
